title: Unctuous Velvety Mediterranean Chicken Wrap
description: A comforting and flavorful dish featuring chicken, apricot jam, and Mediterranean spices, all wrapped in a lotus leaf wrap. Perfect for a sick day or a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the apricot jam and Mediterranean spice blend.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine with the jam and spice mixture.
Warm the lotus leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the chicken and jam mixture onto the center of each wrap and topping with chopped parsley.
